name: OBESynK handwritten marks benchmark
description: Benchmark for handwritten mark extraction from the marks table on the cover page of answer scripts, used to evaluate the OCR module of OBESynK, an open-source academic management system for outcome-based education. It contains 100 smartphone photographs of sample answer-script cover pages, with transcribed ground truth for every cell (rows a–g × 4 questions; handwritten integer marks 0–15). It is split into a development set (30 images, one writer) and a writer-disjoint test set (70 images, seven writers). The pages carry no student names or roll numbers. Camera metadata has been removed; the EXIF Orientation tag is kept and must be applied when reading images 66–100. See README.md for the file formats and for how to reproduce the paper's results.
